test_gradient_boosting_classifier: test GradientBoostingClassifier with various loss functions including log_loss and exponential on toy and synthetic datasets
test_gradient_boosting_regressor: test GradientBoostingRegressor with squared_error, absolute_error, huber, and quantile loss functions on regression datasets
test_gradient_boosting_early_stopping: test gradient boosting early stopping with n_iter_no_change and validation_fraction parameters to auto-determine optimal number of estimators
test_gradient_boosting_warm_start: test warm_start functionality to incrementally add estimators to an existing GradientBoosting ensemble without retraining from scratch
test_gradient_boosting_oob_scores: test out-of-bag scores and improvements with subsample less than 1.0 on both classifier and regressor estimators
